description.value: Pizza 64 is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 2010 with 20+ locations across British Columbia, known for freshly made dough and sauce prepared at each location. The Abbotsford location offers a broad menu of specialty, signature, and gourmet pizzas alongside wings, pasta, and sides. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient takeout stop for cyclists passing through the area.
